spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §7.1 (flags table: bit 2 SPARE — receiver MUST ignore)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §12 (parked: reserved flag bits ignored (not rejected), accepted with D4)
description: A datagram with a reserved flag bit set (bit 2, 0x4) is processed normally — reserved bits are IGNORED, never rejected and never treated as malformed.
preconditions: Note: spec §7.5's malformed-media row also lists 'reserved flag bits set', which conflicts with §7.1's MUST-ignore and with the §12 parked row ('ignored (not rejected)', accepted with D4 by the adjudication). The adjudicated intent is IGNORE; this vector pins it and the §7.5 wording is flagged for the maintainer.

steps.note: flags = 0x00000004: reserved/SPARE bit set; MUST be sent as 0 and ignored on receive.

assertions: The datagram is processed exactly as if flags were 0: decoded, deduped, buffered (§7.5).
A future revision may promote specific reserved bits to mandatory — until then receivers MUST ignore them (§7.1).
Flagged spec gap: §7.5's malformed-media row vs §7.1/§12 — resolved here per the §12 parked row.
